safi-cedvel:1-5.t:
* I'rab:
The adverb (إذا) is attached to the omitted apodosis, i.e. "the souls will know their deeds" [Note: or what is equivalent to it; and it is said: the apodosis is فملاقيه, i.e. "so you are meeting it", in verse (6) of this sūra.] ; (السماء) is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb that the mentioned one after it explains; (لربّها) is attached to (أذنت) [Note: أذنت لربّها: it listened and obeyed.] ; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive (حقّت) is a pronoun referring to السماء, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "its hearing and obedience were due" [Note: or the sky was made fit for listening and compliance, so there is no need to imply a muḍāf.] ; (الأرض) is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being انبسطت; (فيها) is attached to an omitted element that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; and the pronoun in the second (حقّت) refers to الأرض.
Clause: «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ... » has no grammatical position, inceptive.
And the clause: « (انشقّت) السماء ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).
And the clause: «انشقّت (the mentioned one) » has no grammatical position, explicative.
And the clause: «أذنت ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause of the protasis verb.
And the clause: «حقّت ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause of the protasis verb.
And the clause: «the condition, its verb and its apodosis (the second) ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the inceptive clause.
And the clause: « (انبسطت) الأرض ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «مدّت ... » has no grammatical position, explicative.
And the clause: «ألقت ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause انبسطت.
And the clause: «تخلّت ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause ألقت.
And the clause: «أذنت ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause تخلّت.
And the clause: «حقّت ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause أذنت.

* Morphology:
(ألقت): it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, because of the meeting of two sākin letters; the lām of the verb is deleted before the tāʾ of feminine; its pattern is أفعت.
(تخلّت): it has an ʿilāl by deletion, because of the meeting of two sākin letters; the lām of the verb is deleted before the tāʾ of feminine; its pattern is تفعّت.

* Rhetoric:
Implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-makniyya): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَأَلْقَتْ ما فِيها وَتَخَلَّتْ ... » .
Here the state of the earth is likened to the state of a pregnant woman who casts out what is in her belly at the time of hardship and terror; then the thing likened to is omitted, and the word "casting out" is borrowed.
Implicit metaphor: in His saying, the Exalted, «وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّها وَحُقَّتْ ... » .
Here the state of the sky, in its compliance with the effect of Allah's power, the Exalted, wherever He wills, is likened to the compliance of an obedient listener to a command; then the thing likened to is omitted, and the word for permission and listening is borrowed, used in its ultimate sense.

safi-cedvel:6-15.t:
* I'rab:
(أيّها) is a vocative, a specified indefinite noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; (الإنسان) is a badal (substitute) for أيّ, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it, following it in the nominative in form; (إلى ربّك) is attached to (كادح) , with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "to the meeting with your Lord"; (كدحا) is an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (الفاء) is a conjunction; (ملاقيه) is conjoined to كادح, nominative [Note: it may be the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "أنت" (you), the clause having no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the answer to the vocative إنّك كادح.] .
Clause: «the vocative: أيّها الإنسان ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّك كادح ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
7-9 (الفاء) is a conjunction of subdivision (tafrīʿiyya); (أمّا) is a particle of condition and detailing; (من) is a jussive conditional noun in the position of a nominative, a mubtadaʾ; (كتابه) is an accusative mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بيمينه) is attached to (أوتي) ; (الفاء) connects the apodosis; (سوف) is a particle of futurity; (حسابا) is an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq; (إلى أهله) is attached to (ينقلب) ; (مسرورا) is an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of ينقلب; and the clause: «من أوتي ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the answer to the vocative.
And the clause: «أوتي ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: the khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.. and the clause may be the ṣila of (من) if it is parsed as a relative, the clause سوف يحاسب being the khabar, with الفاء added because of the mubtadaʾ's resemblance to a condition.] .
And the clause: «يحاسب ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the condition, accompanied by الفاء.
And the clause: «ينقلب ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause يحاسب.
10-15 (الواو) is a conjunction; (من أوتي كتابه) is like the first; (وراء) is an accusative adverb of place attached to (أوتي) ; (ثبورا) is an accusative mafʿūl bihi, and likewise (سعيرا) ; (في أهله) is attached to (مسرورا) ; (أن) is the lightened form of the heavy one, its ism (subject) omitted, i.e. أنّه.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن لن يحور..) is conjoined, standing in place of the two objects of ظنّ.
(بلى) is a particle of response affirming a negated statement; (به) is attached to (بصيرا) .
And the clause: «من أوتي ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من أوتي (the first).
And the clause: «أوتي ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: refer to the previous page, footnote number (2).] .
And the clause: «سوف يدعو ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of the condition, accompanied by الفاء.
And the clause: «يصلى ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause يدعو.
And the clause: «إنّه كان ... » has no grammatical position, causal.
And the clause: «كان في أهله ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
And the clause: «إنّه ظنّ ... » has no grammatical position, another causal clause ...
And the clause: «ظنّ ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the (second) إنّ.
And the clause: «لن يحور ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the lightened (أن) .
And the clause: «إنّ ربّه كان ... » has no grammatical position, giving the reason for the apodosis implied after بلى, i.e. "yes, he will return to Allah, because his Lord was ever All-Seeing of him".
And the clause: «كان به بصيرا ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the (third) إنّ.

* Morphology:
(6) كادح: an active participle of the triliteral كدح, on the pattern فاعل.
(كدحا): a samāʿī (heard, non-rule-based) maṣdar of the verb كدح (of the bāb of فتح), on the pattern فعل (with fatḥa then sukūn).
(8) مسرورا: a passive participle of the triliteral سرّ, on the pattern مفعول.
(11) يصلى: it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is يصلي: the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa and was turned into alif.

safi-cedvel:16-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive; (لا) is redundant (zāʾida); (بالشفق) is attached to (أقسم) ; (الواو) is a conjunction in the three places; (ما) is a maṣdar (verbal noun) particle [Note: or a relative noun, or an indefinite qualified noun, in the position of a genitive, with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. وسقه..] ; (إذا) is an adverb in the position of an accusative, stripped of the conditional sense, attached to (أقسم) ; (اللام) is the lām of oath; (تركبنّ) is an imperfect verb, nominative, with the nominative sign being the persistence of the nūn, which was deleted because of the succession of similar letters; the wāw, deleted because of the meeting of two sākin letters, is the fāʿil (agent); (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; (عن طبق) is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (طبقا) ..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما وسق) is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to الشفق.
Clause: «لا أقسم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «وسق ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما) [Note: or the ṣila of the relative noun, or in the position of a genitive, a naʿt of the qualified indefinite noun (ما) .] .
And the clause: «اتسق ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).
And the clause: «تركبنّ ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to the oath.

* Morphology:
(16) الشفق: a noun for the mixing of the light of day with the blackness of night after sunset, or a noun for the redness seen on the horizon shortly after sunset.
(18) اتّسق: the wāw, the fāʾ of the word, was changed to tāʾ because it comes before the tāʾ of the form iftaʿala; the origin is اوتسق; its pattern is افتعل.
(19) طبقا: a noun meaning "state"; its pattern is فعل (with two fatḥas).

* Benefits:
- عن:
It occurs in three ways:
1- First: that it be a preposition. All that is mentioned for it comes to ten meanings:
1- Passing beyond: such as: (سافرت عن البلد) ("I travelled away from the town") and (رميت السهم عن القوس) ("I shot the arrow from the bow"). 2- Substitution: as in His saying, the Exalted (وَاتَّقُوا يَوْماً لا تَجْزِي نَفْسٌ عَنْ نَفْسٍ شَيْئاً) , and in the ḥadīth (صومي عن أمك) ("Fast on behalf of your mother").
3- Superiority: as in His saying, the Exalted (فَإِنَّما يَبْخَلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ) .
4- Causation: as in His saying, the Exalted (وَما كانَ اسْتِغْفارُ إِبْراهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ إِلَّا عَنْ مَوْعِدَةٍ) .
5- Synonymous with (بعد) ("after"), as in His saying, the Exalted (عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَيُصْبِحُنَّ نادِمِينَ) and His saying, the Exalted, in the verse we are dealing with (لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقاً عَنْ طَبَقٍ) .
6- Locative: as in the verse of al-Aʿshā Maymūn ibn Qays:
وآس سراة الحي حيث لقيتهم ... ولا تك عن حمل الرباعة وانيا
(Console the leaders of the clan wherever you meet them, and do not be slack in bearing the burden of the blood-money obligations.)
al-Ribāʿa: the stars of al-ḥamāla (blood-money bearing); it is said that ونى ("to be slack") is transitive only with (في) , by the evidence of His saying, the Exalted (وَلا تَنِيا فِي ذِكْرِي) .
7- Synonymous with (من) , as in His saying, the Exalted (هُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبادِهِ) . 8- Seeking help: such as (رميت عن القوس) ("I shot with the bow"), because one says (رميت القوس) .
9- That it be redundant, as a compensation for another omitted one, as in the poet's verse:
أتجزع أن نفس أتاها حمامها ... فهلا التي عن بين جنبيك تدفع
(Do you lament that a soul has been overtaken by its fate? Why do you not defend the one that is between your sides?)
Ibn Jinnī said: he meant فهلا تدفع عن التي بين جنبيك ("why do you not defend the one that is between your sides"); so عن was deleted from the beginning of the relative and added after it.
10- That it be in the sense of الباء, as in His saying, the Exalted: (وَما يَنْطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوى) , i.e.: بالهوى. 2- The second way: that it be a maṣdar particle, because Banū Tamīm say, in a case like أعجبني أن تفعل ("it pleased me that you do"): (عن تفعل) . 3- The third way: that it be a noun meaning "side", as in the verse of Qaṭarī ibn al-Fujāʾa:
فلقد أراني للرماح دريئة ... من عن يميني مرة وأمامي
(I have seen myself a target for spears, at times from my right and at times from before me.)

safi-cedvel:20-21.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) connects the apodosis of an omitted conditional; (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (لهم) is attached to the khabar (predicate) of ما; (لا) is a negative; (الواو) is a conjunction; (عليهم) is attached to (قرئ) ; (لا) is like the first..
Clause: «ما لهم ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an omitted conditional, i.e. if this is their situation on the Day of Resurrection, then what is the matter with them that they do not believe..
And the clause: «لا يؤمنون ... » is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of the absent third person in (لهم) .
And the clause: «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause لا يؤمنون.
And the clause: «قرئ ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).
And the clause: «لا يسجدون» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

safi-cedvel:22-25.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) is for a transitional turning-away (iḍrāb intiqālī); (الواو) is a conjunction, or circumstantial; (ما) is a maṣdar (verbal noun) particle [Note: or a relative noun, or an indefinite qualified noun, in the position of a genitive, with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. يوعونه.] ; (الفاء) connects the apodosis of an omitted conditional; (بعذاب) is attached to (بشّرهم) ; (إلّا) is for exception; (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); (لهم) is attached to an omitted advanced khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (أجر) ; (غير) is a nominative naʿt (adjective) of أجر..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يوعون..) is in the position of a genitive by الباء, attached to (أعلم) , in the sense of عالم ("knowing").
Clause: «الذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «يكذّبون ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) .
And the clause: «الله أعلم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one [Note: or in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial).] .
And the clause: «يوعون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما) [Note: or the ṣila of the relative noun.. or in the position of a genitive, a naʿt of the indefinite noun, the returning pronoun in both being omitted, i.e. يوعونه.] .
And the clause: «بشّرهم ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an omitted conditional, i.e.: if they persist in their denial, then give them glad tidings ...
And the clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
And the clause: «لهم أجر ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption [Note: if (إلّا) is parsed in the sense of لكن ("but"), then the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ and the clause لهم أجر is its khabar.] .

* Morphology:
(23) يوعون: its past is أوعى الشيء, i.e. "he put the thing into a container (wiʿāʾ)", and here it is in the sense of "they conceal"; the verb has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by making sākin and an ʿilāl by deletion; its origin is يوعيون: the ḍamma was found heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made sākin and the ḍamma was transferred to the ʿayn before it (an ʿilāl by making sākin); then the yāʾ was deleted because it met the wāw of the plural while being sākin (an ʿilāl by deletion); its pattern is يفعون (with ḍamma on the yāʾ and the ʿayn).
